system.description:
Taijutsu Specialists who blend their style with the passionate flame exude a level of tenacity unmatched by most in the world of Taijutsu. This group of martial artists are exemplified by green jumpsuits, weighted clothing, and very eccentric haircuts. While this group is mostly associated with the 8-Inner Gates, that technique is formally forbidden from use, and so to avoid having to tap into that potentially fatal reserve of power, they focus on ensuring that their bodies are at the peak of human skill and conditioning beyond all doubts.

Tempo Boost – Combo Extender Keyword

Taijutsu you cast that have the Combo Extender keyword gains the following effect text.

Combo Extender. This Taijutsu is treated as a one with the Combo keyword. Also, until the end of your next turn, you can cast one Taijutsu with the Combo keyword, using either an Action or Bonus action, ignoring its listed casting time.
